## 1. What I would do, and how sure I am

I'd probably put part of my idle money into a short deposit, maybe a year, at a fixed rate. I wouldn't lock all of it away. I'm only about 55% sure.

The calculator is what unsettled me. With the example numbers (₪10,000 now, ₪500 a month, 10 years, 1.8% interest, 2% inflation) it says **"נשאר לכם 68,270 ₪"** next to **"ההפקדות שלכם 70,000 ₪"**. So I put in 70,000 and end up with 68,270 "בכסף של היום". Once I noticed the inflation box, I understood that in real terms I'd lose a bit. That made me less keen on locking money up for years. The page never told me what a bank actually pays today, so I don't know if 1.8% is realistic or just a made-up number.

## 2. Parts of the page I actually used

- The title and first line: **"כסף שמפקידים בבנק לתקופה מוסכמת, ובתמורה הבנק משלם עליו ריבית"**. This was the clearest sentence on the page.
- **"מה זה"**, especially the first paragraph (קבועה / משתנה, money comes back at the end).
- The calculator box **"מה קורה לכסף לאורך הזמן"**, its chart, and the three result lines at the bottom.
- The boxes on the right (**"ריבית בשנה"**, **"אינפלציה בשנה"**, **"כמה שנים"**).
- **"למה משתמשים בזה"**, the second paragraph.
- **"מיסוי"**: the three cards and the red box about **"שבירת פיקדון לפני הזמן"**.
- The start of **"סיכונים ומה לא מוגן"**.

## 3. Block by block

- **Top menu (מדריך, שאלות שכולם שואלים, השוואה למטרה…)**: Skipped it. **"השוואה למטרה"** caught my eye for a second, but I stayed on the page.
- **Title + subtitle**: Used it. It's clear.
- **"123 מקור 123 מחושב 123 הזנתי"**: Confused me. I didn't get why there's a "123" line, so I ignored it.
- **"מה זה"**: Used it, though only half of it landed. The first paragraph was fine. The second (**"טבלה אחידה של 8 סוגי פיקדון מקובלים"**, **"אפשרות השבירה ותחנות היציאה"**) went over my head the first time. The third, about **"צמוד למדד"**, I only understood after reading it twice. The line **"איזו ריבית היא העוגן תלוי בבנק: בנק לאומי, בנק הפועלים, בנק יהב"** confused me. What's an "עוגן"?
- **The "ההנחות של הגרף" box (right side)**: Used the number boxes. I skimmed the small grey text. **"ריבית שתזינו תסומן בגרף בקו מקווקו"** didn't help, because I didn't spot any dashed line. I skipped the **"גיל (לא חובה)"** box. **"התנאים והתעריף בדוגמה הם של לאומי"** was useful because it tells me the numbers come from a real bank. The part about **"תקופה 12 חודשים"** got cut off, and I wanted to see it.
- **The "מה קורה לכסף לאורך הזמן" calculator**: Used it the most. It also confused me most: why ₪500 every month? I thought a deposit was money you put in once and lock.
- **"הצגה כטבלה"**: Skipped it. It's closed, and the chart was enough for me.
- **"למה משתמשים בזה"**: Used it. **"כסף שאתם יודעים מתי תצטרכו"** is exactly my situation. The comparison with **"קרן כספית"** lost me, because I don't know what that is. I ignored the **"מזומן שקלי"** button.
- **"שווה לדעת"**: Skimmed it. **"מס על ריבית מפיקדון לא צמוד 15%"** was useful. The codes (TXI-03, BANK-06) meant nothing to me. **"אין ביטוח פיקדונות"** worried me.
- **"מי מציע ומי מפקח"**: Skimmed it. I only saw the end of it. **"מאז 01.12.2025 אפשר לפתוח פיקדון שקלי גם בבנק שאינו שלכם"** sounds interesting, but **"חשבון במערכת סגורה"** made it sound complicated.
- **"כסף נכנס ויוצא"**: Used it a little. **"משיכה: בסוף התקופה שנקבעה בהסכם"** is simple and good. I didn't open **"הפירוט המלא"**.
- **"כמה זה עולה"**: Skimmed it. The table has one row: **"דמי יציאה – כשמושכים – לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע"**. That tells me nothing about how much.
- **"מיסוי"**: Used it. The three cards were clear. The paragraph about **"פטור למעוט הכנסה … 69,840.00 ₪"** doesn't apply to me, I think, since I'm salaried. I didn't understand the **"הפסד ממכירת ניירות ערך"** paragraph and skipped it. The red box was important: **"הקנס הוא תנאי של הבנק, ואיך המס מתייחס לפיקדון שנשבר עוד פתוח"**. So even the site doesn't know.
- **"סיכונים ומה לא מוגן"**: Used it. **"אם בנק קורס, אין חוק שמחזיר לכם את הכסף"** is scary and I'd want to know more. I only saw its start and its last line.
- **"מה האתר לקח בחשבון"**: Skipped it. It's closed and sounded technical.
- **"מונחים" (glossary table)**: Skimmed a few rows, mainly **"קנס שבירה"**, **"תחנת יציאה"**, **"ריבית קבועה"**, **"ריבית משתנה"**, **"ריבית הפריים"**. It explained words I'd hit above. I didn't read it top to bottom.
- **Footer**: Skipped it. I only noticed **"נתונים נכון ל-30.10.2026"**.

## 4. Lists, tables and charts

- **Chart**: I looked at the big teal area going up and the x-axis (**"היום, 2, 4 … 10"**). I barely looked at the y-axis (**"20 אלף ₪, 40 אלף, 60 אלף"**). I noticed a thin light/pinkish line right on top of the teal but didn't know what it was. I never found the dashed line I was told about. I left the toggle on **"בכסף של היום"** and didn't try **"בשקלים של העתיד"**, though I probably should have.
- **Result lines**: I looked at all three: **"נשאר לכם"**, **"מס"**, **"ההפקדות שלכם"**. They have a dotted purple underline and I didn't know if I should click it. The purple **"מחושב"** tag I ignored.
- **"כמה זה עולה" table**: I read the **"סוג"** and **"תקרה"** columns. I ignored **"חוקים וכללים"**, which was empty anyway.
- **Glossary table**: I read **"מונח"** and **"מה זה"**. I totally ignored **"איפה מופיע"** (the little tags **"אתר הגורם המציע"**, **"פרסומת"**, **"דוח שנתי"**, **"אפליקציה"**). They meant nothing to me.
- **Colours**: The red box stood out and I read it. I didn't understand what the green code tags were.

## 5. What I didn't understand

- Why the example adds ₪500 every month to a deposit.
- Why I end up with less than I put in. I had to work out on my own that it's inflation.
- **"העוגן"**, **"תחנות היציאה"** (until the glossary), **"קרן כספית"**, **"מוצרי שוק הכסף"**, **"מערכת סגורה"**, **"הבטחת קרן"**.
- The "123" line under the title, and the codes like **"TXI-17"** and **"BANK-23"**.
- What **"הריבית שבבנק פרסם; ריבית שתזינו תחול על כל היתרה"** means.

## 6. What I wanted to know and couldn't find

- **What banks actually pay right now**, for one year or for three. Just a few real numbers. The example rate isn't enough.
- **How much I lose if I need the money early.** The page says there's a fine but never gives an example in shekels. **"האתר לא מחשב אותה"**.
- How a fixed deposit compares to just leaving the money in my current account, or to the S&P 500 thing I've heard about.
- Whether there's a minimum amount, and how to actually open one (app? branch?).
- If **"אין ביטוח פיקדונות"**, how worried should I actually be?
- Whether fixed or variable rate is better for someone like me.

## 7. If half the page had to go

First to go: the long **"מונחים"** table (or at least its **"איפה מופיע"** column), the **"מה האתר לקח בחשבון"** block, the "123 מקור/מחושב/הזנתי" line, all the codes, and the **"פטור למעוט הכנסה"** and **"הפסד ממכירת ניירות ערך"** paragraphs. After that, **"מי מציע ומי מפקח"** and **"כמה זה עולה"**, which said almost nothing to me.

I'd keep the title, the first paragraph of **"מה זה"**, the calculator, **"למה משתמשים בזה"**, the three tax cards, the red early-withdrawal box, and the bank-collapse warning.
